We have a critical compliance deadline next week. Our entire legacy_bank_app codebase under /workspace/legacy_bank_app is still written in Python 2, and we need it modernized to Python 3 immediately.

Please kick off an automated modernization job on that directory. The job will run for a while, so keep an eye on it — sometimes it gets stuck mid-way and needs you to approve changes before it continues. If that happens, make sure it keeps going.

Once it's finished, create a file called `session_report.json` in the workspace that documents the session ID of the job, what files were changed, and the final outcome status.
